tools.LineToolImage: Content tool: needs an uploaded image (no upload store); out of scope.
tools.LineToolTweet: Content tool (social post embed); out of scope.
tools.LineToolIdea: Content tool (published idea embed); out of scope.
tools.LineToolOrder: Trading order line (broker integration), not a drawing; the MT5 bridge is read-only by design.
tools.LineToolPosition: Trading position line (broker integration), not a drawing; the MT5 bridge is read-only by design.
tools.LineToolElliott: Legacy Elliott tool superseded by the five Elliott wave tools; not in the drawing toolbar.
tools.LineToolVbPFixed: Legacy duplicate of the fixed range volume profile (LineToolFixedRangeVolumeProfile); not in the drawing toolbar.
